title: Lily Qi on Choosing to be an American - The Wire China
gist: Shanghai-born Lily Qi, who moved to the U.S. at 25 and in 2018 became Maryland's first Chinese-born state legislator, recounts her path from China to American politics in a new memoir, 'Elected American: From Red China to Blue Maryland.'

insights.claim: Lily Qi, born in Shanghai, moved to the U.S. at age 25 and in 2018 became the first Chinese-born state legislator elected in Maryland; she was re-elected in 2022 and is now running for a third term.
insights.speaker: Ella Apostoaie
insights.so_what: Marks a notable milestone in Chinese-American political representation in a U.S. state legislature, relevant to tracking the political integration and influence of the Chinese diaspora in U.S. state-level politics.
insights.quote: Nearly three decades later, she was elected in 2018 as the first Chinese-born state legislator in Maryland. She was re-elected in 2022 and is now running for a third term.

insights.claim: Qi has published a memoir, 'Elected American: From Red China to Blue Maryland,' recounting her journey from China to becoming a U.S. state legislator.
insights.speaker: Ella Apostoaie
insights.so_what: A first-person account of Chinese emigre political integration that could shape narratives around Chinese-American political identity ahead of Qi's third-term campaign.
insights.quote: She recounted her journey from China to the U.S. in a new memoir called Elected American: From Red China to Blue Maryland.
